## The site itself

`docs/` is a Jekyll site deployed by GitHub Actions to GitHub Pages.

- `_data/projects.yaml` is the **single source of truth**. It drives the
  homepage grid, the `/projects/` filter, the footer and each project page's
  header. Project pages look their metadata up by permalink, so a project is
  described in exactly one place.
- `_layouts/` and `_includes/` hold the chrome; `assets/css/style.css` is the
  whole design system.
- `demos/` holds the seven static sites, untouched by Jekyll.

```bash
# local preview
gem install jekyll jekyll-seo-tag
jekyll serve --source docs
```

## Tech stack

What the code in this repository actually uses. Jenkins and Vault were listed
here for a while and appear in none of the projects; they are part of my work
history, not of this repo, so they now live only in the About page.

- **Cloud**: AWS, us-east-2
- **Cluster**: EKS 1.32
- **Registry**: ECR
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions
- **Secrets**: AWS Secrets Manager, with GitHub Actions secrets for deploy credentials
- **IaC**: Terraform, composed with Terragrunt
- **Policy**: OPA/Rego via conftest, plus trivy config
- **Languages**: Node.js, Python, Bash, Go

---

## Usage

Each project folder holds its own code, its Terraform or Kubernetes manifests,
and a `Readme.md` with local run instructions. Nothing here needs a live AWS
account to read; each project page says plainly what has and has not been run
against one.

The README project table is generated. After editing `docs/_data/projects.yaml`:

```bash
python3 scripts/sync-readme.py
```

For detailed guides and screenshots, see the [documentation site](https://tedens.github.io/devops-portfolio/).

---

## Status
This portfolio is actively maintained. Every project has working code and documentation; see each project page for what has and has not been run against a live account.
